competitors.strategy: Make the conversation and composer visually dominant. Render evidence and artifacts as compact receipts with a quiet inspector handoff.
Treat delegated work, evidence receipts, and failures as typed operational objects in a calm chat thread; use a contextual right inspector.
Design one responsive chat surface that visibly supports 10ft glance, 5ft triage, and lean-in drilldown without becoming a dashboard.
Reuse the largest coherent set of existing chat, card, drawer, tooltip, and graph primitives; add the fewest new components.
Prioritize explicit typed turn states, qids, keyboard behavior, and testable evidence/artifact handoffs while preserving the selected mockup.
Prioritize the desktop inspector-to-mobile-drawer transition and distance modes, reusing existing layout and D3 components.
